scientific_role: Determine whether the dominant non-stationarity is national-state uncertainty and whether territorial residuals become transportable conditional on the national result.
important: The national result used in historical evaluation is an ORACLE diagnostic and can never be used as a 2026 forecast input unless supplied as an explicit scenario. This experiment does not claim to predict the 2026 national vote.
national_share_definition: Sum 9-bucket vote counts across the 92 local constituencies, then normalize to the national 9-bucket simplex.

conditional_mean.definition: For each party bucket p, ratio_p = national_next_share_p / national_prior_share_p using epsilon=0.0005. For each territory d, conditional_raw_dp = prior_local_share_dp * ratio_p; renormalize over the 9 buckets.

diagnostics: Actual-share RMSE and MAE: persistence versus oracle-national conditional mean, pooled and by party.
Top-party accuracy and top-S set accuracy where S is the historical constituency magnitude available in the canonical mapping.
Fraction of persistence squared error removed by knowing the national state.

territorial_residual_transfer.residual: actual_next_share - oracle_national_conditional_mean in actual share space
crossfit: Fit territorial residual marginals on 2011_TO_2016, evaluate intervals around the oracle-national 2021 conditional mean.
Fit territorial residual marginals on 2016_TO_2021, evaluate intervals around the oracle-national 2016 conditional mean.
territorial_residual_transfer.eligibility: Every party must clear both coverage floors in both held-out transitions.
territorial_residual_transfer.selection: Lowest calibration error, then narrower 95% width.

interpretation.CONDITIONAL_TRANSFER_PASS: National-state uncertainty is the principal regime variable and territorial residual uncertainty is sufficiently transportable conditional on it. F1 should become a national-scenario-conditioned forecast surface, not one unconditional distribution.
interpretation.CONDITIONAL_POINT_GAIN_BUT_RESIDUAL_FAIL: National state explains substantial point error but territorial residual law remains non-stationary. Publish national-scenario seat surfaces with a conservative pooled territorial envelope, not calibrated unconditional probabilities.
interpretation.NO_CONDITIONAL_GAIN: National conditioning does not materially improve the structural mean; revisit territorial baseline specification before any candidate or agent layer.

forbidden: Call oracle national shares a forecast
Assign probabilities to national scenarios from these two historical transitions
Tune the proportional-swing mapping after seeing held-out results
Reopen E_reason before the conventional conditional baseline is settled
Use transformed residual improvement if actual-share performance worsens
